summary: Retest of the iteration 8 minor fixes for mocked alarm notifications. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (13 in the main run, plus the restart-persistence test re-run once the public HiveMQ broker was back). The fixes work: phone numbers are validated after stripping spaces and dashes (9-15 digits); duplicates are removed after normalising; the event message reads 'Powiadomienia o alarmach WŁ./WYŁ., odbiorcy: N' with meta.user; POST /alarm-settings/test returns 409 when notifications are disabled or there are no recipients; thresholds are rounded (14.399999 -> 14.4, co2 2999.6 -> 3000, alarm body shows '> 5.0°C'); alarm_active persists in db.alarm_state, so after a real 'supervisorctl restart backend' no duplicate ALARM is sent and 'Koniec alarmu: Komora 1' still arrives when the alarm clears. Frontend at 390x844: admin login and live dashboard work (broker connected, device online). The alarm-test button is disabled with 0 recipients or with notifications off, and enabled otherwise. A test send appears under recent. An invalid phone '1 2 3 4' shows an error toast and adds no row. '+48 600-100-200' is shown as '+48600100200'.

issues: The disabled 'Wyślij test' button (alarm-test) looks almost the same as the enabled one. Consider reduced opacity or cursor:not-allowed.
recipient-type is still a native <select> (carried over from iteration 8).

critical_code_review_comments: Environment note: broker.hivemq.com (public broker) was unreachable for about 7 minutes during testing. GATEWAY logged 'Unspecified error' and 'Keep alive timeout', and device_online was false. While offline, the alarm_notifier skips entirely, so alarms that start or clear during a broker outage are not notified. This is expected for a public test broker, but use a private broker in production.
/api/health now requires auth (401 without a cookie). Older tests or monitoring that call it unauthenticated will fail.
server.py is still about 950 lines; the alarm/notifier code could move to its own module.
seed_data_creation: None kept. State restored: recipients empty with enabled=true, alarm_notifications/alarm_state/login_attempts cleared, thresholds 26/28/30 with CO2 3000, setpoints 20/22/24, chamber 3 off, modes auto, simulator on, device online, only the admin user exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. Creating or editing files under backend/tests triggers a backend reload, and the restart test runs 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend'. The SIM/GATEWAY can take 30s to several minutes to reconnect to the public HiveMQ broker; poll the authenticated /api/health for device_online before running notifier tests. Afterwards, run restore_state_it8.py and clear alarm_state. The alarm-enabled checkbox is controlled and updates after the async save, so in Playwright use click() plus a wait, not uncheck().
